title: [task] characterization test for isTenMinRangeOutageError
body:
add a characterization test for isTenMinRangeOutageError in src/tenmin-range-reply-dust.ts: outage message prefixes
- isTenMinRangeOutageError("MASSIVE_HTTP_503 upstream unavailable") is true
- isTenMinRangeOutageError("MASSIVE_HTTP_500") is true
- isTenMinRangeOutageError("MASSIVE_NETWORK connection reset") is true
- isTenMinRangeOutageError("MASSIVE_HTTP_404 not found") is false
- isTenMinRangeOutageError("MASSIVE_HTTP_5000") is false
